leftEvidence.title: Moses intervenes and becomes a fugitive

points.label: Intervention
points.left: Moses sees violence, kills the Egyptian, and hides the body.
points.right: God names Israel’s suffering and explicitly sends Moses to Pharaoh.

points.label: Reception
points.left: A Hebrew asks, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us?”
points.right: Moses asks, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh?”

points.label: Outcome
points.right: The answer is not a résumé but “Certainly I will be with you.”

payload.posture: Read the failed intervention and the later commission separately before holding Moses’ self-understanding beside the role assigned to him.

rightEvidence.title: Moses is sent back with a promise of presence

payload.tension: Read the failed intervention and the later commission separately before holding Moses’ self-understanding beside the role assigned to him.
payload.title: Who am I? / Go, and I will be with you
